name: fieldset-legend
note: fieldset/legend UA defaults (corpus/text-level-ua, text-level UA feature): the fieldset's 2px groove ThreeDFace border (rgb(239,239,239) on this headless Linux), 2px inline margins and 0.35em/0.625em block + 0.75em inline padding; the legend participates in the fieldset box — it is pulled out of flow, shrinks to fit, straddles the block-start border (flush with the border-box top when taller than the border) and pushes the content down by its protrusion — all without table layout.
